process.title: Our Process
process.description: Discover the key steps we follow to take your project from the initial idea to a solid brand identity and a striking web presence.

steps.label: Starting the journey
steps.content: In this first stage, you'll tell us about your brand, the goals you want to achieve, your target audience, and any special features you'd like. The goal is to have a clear vision of the project from the start and make sure we are all aligned. Here, we also gather the key details for planning and executing the project.

steps.label: Research and Analysis
steps.content: With the information gathered, we begin a deep research phase. We analyze your competitors, the market you are in, and design trends that could benefit your business. This phase also includes an analysis of best practices, methods, and tools that will be useful for the project's development.

steps.label: Creative Proposal
steps.content: With the research and analysis in hand, we present an initial creative proposal. Here we show sketches or wireframes that reflect the structure and design of the site, as well as a visual proposal for the graphic identity. We focus on how the site will reflect your brand, how the content will be organized, and how it will improve the user experience.

steps.label: Development and Design
steps.content: Once the design and structure are approved, we begin the development process. In this stage, our web design and development team will build your site using best practices in front-end and back-end development. We use technologies like WordPress or Astro.js, depending on the approach that best fits your project. Here the final visual design is created and all necessary functionalities are integrated.

steps.label: Testing and Review
steps.content: With the site developed, we start an exhaustive testing phase. We review functionality across different devices, browsers, and use cases to make sure everything works perfectly. We also show you the site to get your feedback and make adjustments as needed. We additionally optimize SEO and set up analytics and metrics tools.

steps.label: Launch and Final Delivery
steps.content: Once everything has been reviewed and approved, it's time to launch your website. We deploy it to the server, configure the domain, and verify that everything works perfectly. We make sure the site is ready for user traffic and provide post-launch support for any adjustment or update that may be needed.
